source_text: The patient has hypertension and should reduce sodium intake.
target_text: You have high blood pressure. Eating less salt may help. Ask your care team what daily salt limit is right for you.

target_text: Your average blood sugar has been higher than the goal range. Talk with your care team about your diabetes plan.

source_text: Take this medication BID with meals and monitor for adverse gastrointestinal effects.
target_text: Take this medicine twice a day with food. Call your care team if you have stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.

source_text: The imaging study shows no acute cardiopulmonary abnormality.
target_text: Your scan does not show a new serious problem with your heart or lungs.

source_text: Use the inhaler PRN for dyspnea or wheezing.
target_text: Use the inhaler when needed for shortness of breath or wheezing. Ask your care team how often it is safe to use.

source_text: The lesion appears benign, but interval follow-up is recommended.
target_text: The spot does not look cancerous right now. Your care team recommends checking it again later.

source_text: Renal function is mildly decreased compared with prior labs.
target_text: Your kidney test is a little lower than before. Ask your care team what this means for you.

source_text: The patient denies chest pain but reports intermittent palpitations.
target_text: You said you do not have chest pain, but you sometimes feel your heart beating fast or irregularly.

source_text: Continue analgesic therapy as tolerated.
target_text: Keep taking your pain medicine if it is helping and not causing problems. Contact your care team if side effects occur.

target_text: There is a small amount of swelling in both legs or feet.

target_text: The cause of your symptoms is still not clear after the first tests.

source_text: Discontinue the medication if rash, facial swelling, or respiratory symptoms occur.
target_text: Stop taking the medicine and get medical help if you develop a rash, face swelling, or trouble breathing.

source_text: The electrocardiogram shows sinus tachycardia without ischemic changes.
target_text: Your heart rhythm test shows a fast regular heartbeat. It does not show signs of reduced blood flow to the heart.

source_text: The patient should follow up in clinic for medication reconciliation.
target_text: Please schedule a clinic visit so your care team can review all of your medicines.

source_text: No contraindication to vaccination was identified today.
target_text: Based on today's review, there was no clear medical reason found that would prevent vaccination.

target_text: You are a little dehydrated. Drinking more fluids may help unless your care team has told you to limit fluids.

target_text: The tissue sample showed inflammation. It did not show cancer.

source_text: The patient was counseled on lifestyle modification for cardiovascular risk reduction.
target_text: Your care team discussed healthy habits that may lower your chance of heart disease.

target_text: Avoid medicines like ibuprofen or naproxen because you have had a stomach ulcer.
